title: Event card and editor: details first, Save at the bottom, guest suggestions, calendar menu
steps: Click an invitation, then one of your own events
Click a free slot; in Add guests type the first letters of a contact and press Return
Pick another calendar in the Calendar menu, then press Esc
expected: An invitation shows its time, a Join Google Meet button, place, guests with their answers, notes and Going? at the bottom. Your own event shows the form with Cancel and Save at the bottom and Duplicate and Delete in •••. Add guests suggests contacts as in the composer. No sentence about Google emailing guests shows.
